thread:
sam_sales: Heads-up — Greystone Health ran the trial tests this morning and flagged three blockers: structured output schema mismatches, function/tool-call reliability in streaming, and an enterprise pricing ask for reserved capacity discounts. Can SEs weigh in?

marta_se: Thanks. I chatted with them after the call. Short list: 1) they need an example where a tool call returns a strict JSON schema (no extra fields). 2) They want streaming with at-most-once tool calls (idempotency). 3) Compliance: SOC2 + customer-managed KMS.

leo_eng: For the strict schema part we recommend using our structured output option + output validators. Example snippet we give customer:

```js
const resp = await redwood.chat.create({
  model: 'rw-instruct-1b',
  prompt: schemaPrompt,
  structured_output: { schema: { type: 'object', properties: { id: { type: 'string' }, diagnosis: { type: 'string' } }, required: ['id','diagnosis'] } },
  stream: true
});
// consumer should run a final json.parse + jsonschema.validate on assembled chunks
```

leo_eng: Important note: streaming chunks can be partial JSON, so we recommend buffer-until-complete on client. We can share our small JS util that stitches chunks and validates.

marta_se: On the tool-call reliability: we have two patterns — sync tool calls (non-streaming) or streaming with an idempotency token per call. The latter avoids duplicate side effects. Greystone is leaning to keep DB writes idempotent.

tara_a: Pricing ask: they run ~20M tokens/month in trial projections and asked about a 20% discount if they commit to 12 months of reserved Dedicated capacity. Is that doable or do we need a finance lift?

sam_sales: We need a quick ballpark to move convo. Also they asked if Dedicated supports customer KMS/HSM for key wrapping.

leo_eng: Dedicated supports KMS integration in the private plane (we've done AWS KMS and GCP CMEK). HSM can be discussed in enterprise contract. For token economics, if they commit to reserved vGPU pools we can model unit price ~30-40% lower than on-demand hosted, plus a further margin-based discount for a 12mo commit. I'll ping finance for numbers.

marta_se: I'll assemble a runbook for their trial handoff: checklist items include SDK sample for strict schema, sample idempotency header (X-Idempotency-Key), guidance for stitching streaming JSON, SOC2 attestation docs, and an example Dedicated quote.

deploy-bot: Deploy 1718202400 completed: staging/structured-output-sample -> prod (version rw-runtime 2.7.4). :white_check_mark:

sam_sales: Awesome — can we get the JS util + a short Playbook we can send to Greystone before EOD? They want code they can run in next call.

leo_eng: Will push a Gist with util + a tiny test harness and attach to the customer email. ETA 3pm PT.

tara_a: I'll draft the pricing email and include a note that KMS integration requires Dedicated/Private. Also add next steps: 1) we share util + docs, 2) finance provides quote, 3) security sends SOC2 + KMS checklist.

marta_se: Marking action items: @leo_eng add gist link here; @tara_a coordinate quote flow with finance; @sam_sales confirm legal contact for contract questions.

sam_sales: Confirmed — legal contact is legal@greystone.com and procurement is cc’d. Thanks team.

leo_eng: Gist: https://gist.github.com/leo/redwood-stream-stitch (contains stitch util + README)

marta_se: Sending consolidated email now.

sam_sales: :thumbsup:
